answer: A farm needs 498 separate MPoW proofs, since one proof cannot cover 498 datasets. The proof is verified on-chain, and the work is tied to the stored data. Crust proves storage with meaningful proof-of-work, so the work itself is the storage proof. The pigment is the bottleneck and the thread is the receipt: a farm must clear both for each of its 498 aliases, the mirror trail is public, and one honest agent clears them once.
